milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The agent must navigate near the red nether brick wall structure (centered at ~5, ~1, ~4) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at the wall. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks per the design guidelines.
